subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: What live workload and success bar should be required before this broad Gateway load-stability issue can be closed or split into narrower fixes?
rationale: Current main has meaningful partial mitigations, but the issue reports a multi-handler, multi-agent availability failure and there is no current-main live proof that the same workload no longer stalls or times out.

options.title: Keep Canonical Blocker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and require a sanitized diagnostics export plus current-main large-session live proof before closing or splitting it.

options.title: Split Narrow Hotspots
options.body: Create maintainer-scoped follow-ups for specific remaining hotspots such as sync store load, transcript indexing, or compaction latency, then close this only after the follow-ups cover the user-visible failure.

options.title: Accept Partial Fixes
options.body: Treat the merged sessions.list/log-tail/compact work as sufficient and close this, accepting the risk that the broad live workload remains unproven.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Blocker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and require a sanitized diagnostics export plus current-main large-session live proof before closing or splitting it.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Gateway sessions/log-tail lines and recent release-side history point to Vincent Koc as the best available routing candidate for the proof bar and scope decision.
